study_units.title: Adults with developmental disabilities
study_units.structural_rationale: Final MCC scope adjudication identified objective 21-1 as the single true scope gap after deterministic comparison with all 1,486 Toronto Notes-derived study units. The closest units address pediatric developmental delay, disability etiologies, generic consent/capacity, or generic health equity, but none represents the integrated adult-specific care competency. This unit is therefore derived only from the canonical MCC objective and carries no Toronto Notes node or page provenance.

crosswalk_entries.title: Adults with developmental disabilities

mcc_evidence.mapping_rationale: Direct match to canonical MCC objective 21-1. The unit is intentionally MCC-derived because the completed Toronto Notes scope lacks an integrated adult developmental-disability care unit.

testable_competencies.assessment_and_communication: For an adult with developmental disability, assess intellectual and adaptive functioning, adapt communication, and recognize common physical, mental, and behavioural concerns, including atypical serious illness or pain and risk of abuse or neglect.
testable_competencies.consent_and_support: Assess the patient's ability to provide voluntary informed consent and appropriately incorporate input from caregivers or support workers.
testable_competencies.initial_management: Initiate disability-appropriate investigation, screening and preventive care, medication-safety review, and interdisciplinary coordination while anticipating longer-term health and safety needs.

do_not_test: Specific syndrome surveillance schedules or current clinical recommendations without later source verification.
